1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Displaced Persons Laws
Amendment Ordinance, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

3. Validation. Anything
done, action taken, order passed, rule made or notification issued, or
purporting to have been done, taken, passed, made or issued, under any of the
aforesaid Acts, before the promulgation of this Ordinance, shall be deemed to
have been done, taken, passed, made or issued under such Act as amended by this
Ordinance, and shall have and shall be deemed always to have had effect
accordingly.
